description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeReportingMethodDao class responsible for database operations related to employee reporting hierarchies within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving report relationships, searching and counting supervisors/subordinates, deleting relationships, and retrieving specific report-to records based on employee IDs.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing employee reporting relationships, including CRUD operations and search functionalities related to supervisor and subordinate relationships.

methods.name: saveEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Persists a ReportTo entity representing a reporting relationship and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: searchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Searches for immediate supervisors of an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the search criteria.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Deletes supervisor relationships for a given employee and set of supervisor IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships for a given supervisor and set of subordinate IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Searches for subordinates of an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ReportTo relationship between two employee IDs, if it exists.

methods.name: getExistingSubordinateIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns subordinate IDs that already have a reporting relationship with the specified supervisor.

methods.name: getExistingSupervisorIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns supervisor IDs that already report to the specified subordinate.
